Print Layout Optimizer

Fit multiple photos onto US Letter, A4, or 4×6 inch paper with uniform margins. Zero server uploads — all processing happens directly in your browser.

What it does

Calculates optimal 2x2 and 3x2 grid layouts to fit multiple personal photographs onto standard printer sheets while enforcing balanced white borders. Automatically computes aspect ratio scaling factors to ensure photos are presented cleanly without awkward perspective distortion or subject truncation.

How to use

  1. Select your destination paper format (US Letter, A4 international, 4x6 photo paper, or A3 poster sheet).
  2. Add between 1 and 12 photographs from your computer or camera memory card.
  3. Examine the real-time layout canvas for spacing, alignment, and outer border balance.
  4. Click the download button to receive a crisp 300 DPI composite file ready for printing.

Limits & Considerations

Scales images using uniform letterboxing to preserve native aspect ratios. Does not support arbitrary freehand collaging, diagonal rotation, or polygonal cropping.

Privacy & Security

Your family snapshots and personal prints remain strictly on your machine. Client-side canvas processing ensures complete data isolation.
